summary.text: Elder Vogel Jr. is a Republican who has represented Pennsylvania's 47th Senatorial District, which includes parts of Beaver, Butler and Lawrence Counties, since 2009; he chairs the Senate Agriculture & Rural Affairs Committee and is vice chairman of the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Before joining the Senate, Vogel was president of the Beaver-Lawrence Farm Bureau and a New Sewickley Township supervisor.

His biography credits him with legislation including Act 42 of 2024, expanding telemedicine, and Act 59 of 2023, expanding access to sexual assault nurse examiners, and says he led the Farming First legislation.
Vogel and his wife Sue operate a family farm in New Sewickley Township that was established in 1873, and he serves on the board of the Lawrence County Community Action Partnership.
